_comment: Submitting to TestFlight/App Store needs values tied to your Apple account,
so they are not committed. To submit, merge this block into eas.json (which
is committed without it) and fill in your own identifiers, or pass the API
key via the EXPO_ASC_* environment variables from .env.example instead.
If you sign with your own certificate rather than letting EAS manage it,
add "credentialsSource": "local" to the production build profile and
create a credentials.json (gitignored) pointing at your .p12 and profile.
